name: Multisite Manager Tool
description: Simplifies management of Drupal multisite installations.
project_description:
Multisite Manager Tools is a Drupal module designed to facilitate the management of basic administrative tasks across multiple sites within a Drupal multisite environment.

 Features 
 
 Detect and list all active multisites. 
 Clear cache for a specific multisite from the admin interface, and for all sites at the same time. 
 Create new site (generate directory, settings file, database if needed) 
 Site configuration entity with JSON:API support — stores site information as configuration entities, useful for frontends to discover available sites. 
 Headless project support — register both backend and frontend URLs for each multisite. 
 Site reconciliation — automatically detect and register existing sites when installing the module on a multisite that already has multiple sites configured. 
 Please make sure that the configured database user has the correct permission to be able to create databases. 

 
 Post-Installation 
 you can manage your Drupal multisite instances from the administration page:

 Go to: /admin/config/system/multisite-manager
